environment.description: IoT gateway appliance running on Ubuntu 22.04 bare metal. Flask app runs as `iot-service` user with read access to /etc/shadow and /etc/iot/. The HTTP endpoint is exposed on the internal VLAN (172.16.0.0/16) accessible from employee workstations. No reverse proxy or WAF in front. Browsers on the same network can reach port 8443 directly. The iot-mgmt binary exists at /usr/local/bin/iot-mgmt and runs with elevated privileges via setuid bit.

config.network: flat L2 VLAN, no segmentation between IoT management and user workstations
